key_absences: Matthew Golden (WR, shoulder/foot, DNP, status unclear)
home.summary: Green Bay is 4-3 and last in the NFC North after a 20-17 loss at Detroit that ended a three-game win streak; Trey Smack missed a 35-yard field goal late and the Packers failed to cash in at the Detroit 22. They play a short-week home game with rookie John Williams reportedly set to start at center because Rhyan and Monk are out. LaFleur said 'we can't feel sorry for ourselves' and is hopeful but unsure about Golden. Coverage frames the Packers as the more stable side but with a run game ranked last in the league.

notes.text: Both interior centers (Rhyan, Monk) unavailable; rookie John Williams reportedly starts at center.
Micah Parsons remains out, leaving the pass rush at a 21.4% pressure rate (16th).
WR Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) did not practice Mon or Tue; LaFleur 'sure hope[s]' he plays.
Run game is the league's weakest by yards per carry and total yards (59.9 per game); Jacobs had 36 yards on 11 carries vs Detroit.
Defense held Detroit to 20 points and is ranked 5th in EPA/play; recovered two fumbles in the loss.
Eight roughing-the-passer penalties this season versus zero for opponents; more flags in Detroit wiped out an interception.
Rookie kicker Trey Smack missed a 26- and a 35-yard field goal in the Lions loss.

scheme_trends.trend: Third-down conversion rate ranks 28th and red-zone touchdown rate 30th; two recent wins came by three points over weaker teams.
Above-average by EPA/play (5th); gave up 10 touchdowns to running backs.

away.summary: Carolina is 3-3 and still leads the NFC South after a 43-13 home loss to Tampa Bay, who ran for 258 yards and led 33-6 at halftime. Young lost a strip-sack fumble and was replaced by Kenny Pickett in the fourth quarter, and Moton broke his fibula after returning from blood clots. The Panthers travel on a short week with a reshuffled line and thin secondary. Entering Week 7 Young had led the NFL in passing yards per game.

notes.text: Moton (RT) broke his fibula vs Tampa and is on IR; rookie Monroe Freeling replaced him.
CB Jaycee Horn has a torn quad (IR); CB Mike Jackson hurt his groin; secondary is thin against Green Bay's receivers.
Carolina allowed 258 rushing yards to Tampa after allowing 81 in the prior two games combined; it allows the most rushing yards per game (153.2).
Young threw 14-of-27 for 163 yards, was sacked five times and replaced by Pickett late; Carolina scored 13.
Phillips (OLB) is a close call for Thursday per Canales.
Guard Damien Lewis (knee) did not practice Monday; WR Jalen Coker was limited with a shoulder injury.

scheme_trends.trend: Run defense collapsed vs Tampa (258 yards) and ranks near the bottom of the league against the run.

narrative.consensus_narrative: Both teams are coming off losses and patching injuries on a short week. Carolina's run defense against Green Bay's weak rushing attack is the most-cited matchup, with Green Bay's missing centers and Parsons and Carolina's tackles and cornerbacks as the offsetting concerns. Consensus pages show the moneyline leaning toward the Packers while the spread is near an even split.

matchup_notes.text: Carolina's run defense is among the league's worst while Green Bay's run game is the league's weakest; several outlets frame Jacobs as a bounce-back candidate.
Carolina's offensive line is reshuffled (Moton out, Ekwonu out, Freeling at RT) against a Parsons-less Green Bay pass rush, with Young under pressure in sacks per game.
Both teams are thin at key positions on a short week: Green Bay at center and linebacker, Carolina at tackle and cornerback.
